description: Canonical metadata for a game leaderboard, published in the game's own AT Protocol repository.

main.description: Defines one leaderboard offered by a game (modeled on Google Play Games Services leaderboards and symmetrical with `games.opengaming.achievement.definition`). Publish in the game publisher's repository using a stable slug rkey (e.g. `high-score`, `most-likes`).

game.description: AT-URI of the game definition record (e.g. `games.atmosphere.define`) in the publisher's repository.

name.description: Display name of the leaderboard (e.g. `High Scores`, `Fastest Clear`).

description.description: Optional explanation of what this leaderboard tracks and any rules.

icon.description: Required square icon representing this leaderboard (512x512 PNG or WebP recommended; avoid localized text inside the image).

iconAlt.description: Accessibility alt text for the leaderboard icon.

sortOrder.description: Ranking direction. `largerIsBetter` for points/collectibles; `smallerIsBetter` for speedruns/elapsed time. Once published, `sortOrder` SHOULD NOT be changed.

scoreFormat.description: How raw integer score values are formatted (`numeric`, `time`, or `currency`).

timeframes.description: Which leaderboard time windows this game tracks and displays for this board (e.g. `["allTime"]` for a single permanent board, or `["daily", "weekly", "allTime"]` for rotating + historical boards).

recordPolicy.description: Controls how player `leaderboard.score` records are written for this board: `bestOnly` overwrites a single personal-best record per player (ideal when `timeframes` is `["allTime"]`); `perWindowBest` appends a timestamped record whenever beating the player's active Daily, Weekly, or All-Time best; `everyRun` appends a record for every completed run.

scoreMin.description: Optional minimum valid raw score. Indexers and AppViews MUST discard score submissions below `scoreMin`.

scoreMax.description: Optional maximum valid raw score. Indexers and AppViews MUST discard clearly fraudulent submissions above `scoreMax`.

listOrder.description: Optional sort index controlling the display order among a game's leaderboards.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this leaderboard definition was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this leaderboard definition was last updated.
